title: Experience gives an ending structure
meaning: Shared closure of earlier participation through understood experience is emotionally answered by clear boundaries and a sense of common support.
text: In this pair’s Energy Field, Death in the physical position concerns shared actions that end an earlier form or phase. The Hermit in energy motivates drawing on understood experience and sharing what has become clear. The Emperor in emotions adds a feeling of support when events have a definite arrangement. The overall tone can be organised and thoughtful: you perform a particular closure using earlier understanding, while emotionally finding satisfaction in defined boundaries, responsibility and a clear place for each person within the ending.

For example, you finish running a shared club and pass its materials to the next pair of organisers. Experience of an earlier handover suggests what needs separate labelling and explanation. Once the final session is held and the keys returned, calm arrives. **We have completed our part, and the boundaries of our participation are now clear.** Emotional support concerns the understandable arrangement of closure, rather than keeping the club’s entire future under your control.

A difficulty arises if your own experience becomes a final scheme the new participants must preserve. Closure has formally happened, but the emotional need for order continues to retain earlier responsibility. The Hermit makes no past understanding universal, and the Emperor in emotions grants no right to define boundaries for everyone. Death concerns an actual ending of particular participation; it does not require control over every subsequent action in the undertaking. The value of your experience can remain without that authority.
